scope: C-01–C-07 Halo 配對：每套一款具名非士官長裝甲
selection_rule: 依真正原版裝甲形狀找相似具名 Halo 款；圖像是開發概念、官方模型渲染或遊戲截圖，無同人圖、cosplayer照片、士官長標準盔。
armor_family_note: Grenadier/Recon/Operator/EVA 可出現在 Mark 系列底衣平台，但選用的是它們自己具辨識特徵的非士官長頭盔，未使用 Mark IV/V/VI/VII 標準主盔。
verification: 逐張使用 tools.view_image 親自觀看；作者來源由相關 File 頁讀取。對照結論為本次設計判斷，並非來源作者的融合建議。

observed.helmet: 低圓頂、額前短水平遮沿、深色寬面罩；頰部與下巴形成可容納人頭的收口；額頂一條淺色縱帶。
observed.torso: 厚雙胸板位於布衣外、肩上扣帶清楚；小分層肩甲讓上臂仍可活動，腰帶和腹部小袋把軟硬材質分開；正常人手、膝與脛比例。
observed.back: 已見完整背包：上窄下收的長方硬殼主艙，兩側直立細長模組、中央短橫槽、兩條彎肩帶與腰帶。

matches.match_reason: Viper 的圓冠、寬面罩、黑肩與雙胸板可以直接接上 ODST 的穿戴層次。ODST 比高階 Mjolnir 更接近原版入門兵装，也較能避免再次變成機器人。
matches.integration_en: Fuse the original Star Warfare Viper identity with the Halo 3 ODST Rookie's practical human-worn construction. Keep Viper's steel-blue shell, purple continuous glass visor, black crown channel, black shoulder caps and paired inward-slanting dark chest apertures. Borrow the ODST's short brow rim, close-fitting cheek enclosure, layered small pauldrons, visible shoulder straps, soft waist and compact harness-mounted field-pack logic. Redesign the exact panel outlines, fasteners and backpack shell; do not transplant the Rookie's white helmet stripe, logos or pouch layout. Make the body visibly occupied by a human, with natural upper arms, flexible elbows and real gloves. Preserve the existing game backpack ID independently; the ODST pack is a construction reference, not an automatic replacement mapping.

matches.variant: Recon helmet with UA/HUL[3] option; Recon-equipped Spartan upper body

observed.helmet: 寬而較扁的琥珀面罩；周圍寬下巴框與黑色面部內層；圓滑低冠配额前低支架，頰側斜長連續框。
observed.torso: 胸前大 U 形硬甲框留出頸胸布衣；下方腹片逐段縮窄；附圖左肩比右肩厚，肩帶/胸口工具袋可見。
observed.back: 未取得該套完整背視；正面上肩後的小外殼不作背包輪廓證據。

matches.match_reason: Fortune 原版與 Recon 都有寬頰護、方下巴包住較扁面罩，以及 U 形胸框。對應的是輪廓與穿戴方式，不只是同為藍色。
matches.integration_en: Fuse Fortune's dark-green and blue-gray armor, deep plum visor, broad cheek guards and pale U-shaped chest border with the Halo Reach Recon helmet's low rounded crown, protected narrow-wide visor and slanting chin frame. Use a compact, redesigned brow equipment mount rather than copying Recon's attachment silhouette. Borrow the shoulder harness, protected collar opening and ribbed abdomen from the Recon-equipped reference, then simplify them to Fortune's broad readable panels. Keep a visible human neck, black-brown flexible suit and layered modest pauldrons. Retain Fortune's pale rectangular downward chest tab as the principal chest cue. The donor references do not establish a rear pack, so design the rear connection against the separately audited original game backpack instead of inventing a canonical Recon backpack.

matches.variant: Grenadier / Jorge-052 heavy armor, without character markings

observed.helmet: 非常厚的水平眉甲、大橙金面罩、中央下沿小凸口；圓耳護與厚下頰；冠頂可裝折疊/裝甲模組。
observed.torso: 很厚且不對稱的護頸、胸口硬框與腹部軟袋；圓大肩甲分層包在上臂外；胯、肘与膝有清楚人類活動區。
observed.back: 全身圖僅前角，可見後領高度；完整背部及獨立背包未見。

matches.match_reason: Tank 原版厚眉、橙面罩、分節冠與上翹短肩對應 Grenadier 的重防護盔和爆震肩領；兩者均可維持厚甲與人類身體。
matches.integration_en: Fuse Tank's steel-blue and sage-green armor, broad orange visor, segmented low crown strip and short upturned green shoulder lips with Halo Reach Grenadier's thick protective brow, deep cheek-and-chin enclosure and layered blast-collar construction. Replace the donor's specific forehead mount with a simpler segmented crown that echoes Tank. Build substantial shoulder and shin thickness around an athletic human rather than inflating every limb into a block. Retain the green edging around blue thigh plates and the green collar ring. Borrow Grenadier's heavy collar and practical soft abdomen, but omit Jorge's number, personal paint, exact asymmetrical shoulder marking and ammunition props. No rear donor has been observed; retain backpack independence and use the actual original-game pack reference to complete the back.

observed.helmet: 大連續金色面罩、圓冠，額頭前端懸掛三鏡头夜視模組；下巴是有垂直窄槽的方形護板，兩側有獨立耳護。
observed.torso: 斜長胸肩帶與頸口留有黑布；肩前缘短平板与向下包覆的立體肩殼；前臂長護板下仍可見手腕與手套。
observed.back: 參考只含前方與上側，未見後背；不能把前肩殼當背包。

matches.match_reason: Hydra 原版額前方塊、大黃綠面罩與短肩片，可以融合 Operator 的額前設備與輕型肩構造。只保留一個低矮設備盒，原樣移植三個大鏡頭會削弱 Hydra 的面罩身份。
matches.integration_en: Fuse Hydra's blue-green shell, yellow-green continuous visor, small green-framed forehead block, short segmented crown and short flared green shoulder blades with Halo Reach Operator's compact optical-equipment mounting and articulated shoulder construction. Translate the three-lens night-vision bar into ONE small low-profile rectangular brow module integrated with Hydra's original block; keep the visor fully visible so the character reads as a human wearing armor. Borrow Operator's protected chin, flexible black neck, sloping shoulder strap and slim forearm plating, but reduce accessory clutter and remove the donor's checker markings. Preserve Hydra's lighter silhouette compared with Tank. The back is not observed in this donor; pair it only with the separately selected original-game backpack, with a newly designed compact harness.

observed.helmet: 有中央低冠條的圓分面殼、寬連續面罩中間下沿向下延伸、黑色頰框與分片下巴。
observed.torso: X/U形胸甲由兩條斜向硬框圍成；肩殼分上下兩片且邊緣夾小側片；大腿板外移留下黑色人形胯與腹。
observed.back: 完整後視可見兩條分開的長縱向背甲外殼、上肩後獨立模組、脊中圓/方小機件，中央與腰部仍為黑色布衣；這是裝甲背部構造，不是獨立行囊。

matches.match_reason: Strike 的全封閉金色面罩、額冠節點與肩前臂發光點，能融合 Recruit 分面殼、較人體化的黑色胯腹和明確背甲模組。兩者有連續面罩与少量青色機件的共同點。
matches.integration_en: Fuse Strike's steel-blue armor, wide golden visor, vented brow and turquoise circular or hexagonal status nodes with Halo 4 Recruit's segmented rounded helmet, separated shoulder layers, sloping chest frame and human-shaped black flexible abdomen. Rebuild the helmet outlines around Strike's wide visor rather than copying Recruit's exact facial cutout. Concentrate the turquoise nodes on the crown, one shoulder region and forearm; reduce the scattered circuitry to improve readability. Borrow the rear design principle of two spaced vertical armored housings with a clear flexible spine channel, redesigning their shapes and connection points. These housings are part of the suit, not a freestanding backpack; leave a separate hardpoint for the actual mapped game backpack. Keep athletic human hips, exposed textile elbow folds and normal gloves.

matches.variant: EVA, original multiplayer armor concept and game appearance

補充：遊戲中 EVA 大面罩與胸部，低解析僅款式確認

reviewed_not_primary_images.reason: 同設計的較小舊裁圖已看過；改用上方有明確作者來源的完整原稿。

observed.helmet: 大金色泡形面罩覆蓋幾乎整張臉，上下均為連續反射玻璃；側頰小型連接件，圓頂厚框與短下巴。
observed.torso: 平緩 U 形胸甲框，中下胸獨立雙圓端口盒；圓肩加外側方形夾層；肘、腹與大腿內面是人體柔性層。
observed.back: 前方角度可見一側肩後大型上立方形外殼；沒有後視，不能推論完整背包形狀或作用。

matches.match_reason: Titan 原版最大特色是一路延到下臉的金色大面罩；EVA 的大視野圓罩與圓厚肩直接相近。融合保留 Titan 臂上三點和黃橙肩邊，可以避免只變成換色 EVA。
matches.integration_en: Fuse Titan's large gold faceplate, steel-blue frame, three small yellow forearm nodes and orange-edged yellow shoulder band with Halo 3 EVA's broad curved glazing and practical rounded pressure-helmet construction. Give the faceplate a newly designed lower polygonal edge that recalls Titan instead of copying the EVA fishbowl. Borrow the rounded shoulder volume, visible underarm joints, soft black abdomen and detachable service-module logic, while preserving Titan's blue armored limbs and readable yellow trim. Avoid adding a robot face or lens eyes behind the glass. Redesign any chest service block instead of copying the donor's exact paired circular sockets. Only an upper rear housing edge is visible in the donor; the complete pack shape must come from the separately mapped original-game backpack and new design work.

observed.helmet: 短低中央冠條、厚頰側與下巴殼；內側面部有很強的鼻口/骷髏暗示，不適合原樣融合給本次人穿裝甲方向。
observed.torso: 兩道厚胸框匯入中央橫件，肩蓋與其下小臂上片分離；長四肢、黑紡織底衣、明確肘部活動區。
observed.back: 完整後視：肩後兩條細長斜立外殼圍住脊中圓形接點，下端連到肩胛下方弧片；腰背保留連續柔性層。這是整套背甲/設備外殼，不是獨立背包。

matches.match_reason: Thunder 的原版中央鰭冠與圓耳盤可借 War Master 的低冠脊和厚側頰重新變成人能穿的盔。War Master 肩層和胸框能優化厚甲；它的骷髏臉應捨去，保留 Thunder 原橙金面罩。
matches.integration_en: Fuse the actual original Star Warfare Thunder's steel-blue and gold identity, orange-gold continuous visor, round ear discs and distinctive rear-swept central fin with Halo 4 War Master's compact crown structure, protected cheeks, layered shoulder caps and armored chest-frame construction. Lower and thicken Thunder's fin into a short swept reinforcement ridge that still reads as Thunder; do not erase it entirely. Keep a full uninterrupted glass visor and a simple chin guard, explicitly removing War Master's skull-like nose and mouth motif. Borrow the back's spaced oblique equipment housings around a flexible central spine and redesign their contours to harmonize with Thunder's round ear discs and gold rear-head lines. Treat these as suit structure with a separate pack mounting point. Use a broad athletic human torso and natural limb anatomy, not a robot skeleton.
